field_definitions.experiment_id: string: Unique identifier (EXP-C-NNNNNN for classical, EXP-Q-NNNNNN for quantum)
field_definitions.priority: enum: P0 (mandatory), P1 (important), P2 (optional), REJECTED, DEFERRED
field_definitions.status: enum: READY, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED, DEFERRED, REJECTED
field_definitions.representation_id: string: Links to Phase 6 feature representation (REP-NNN or QREP-NNN)
field_definitions.model_id: string: Links to Phase 7/8 model definition (CMODEL-XXX or QMODEL-XXX)
field_definitions.shots: integer: Number of measurement repetitions per circuit execution
field_definitions.comparison_group_id: string: Groups experiments for fair scientific comparison in Phase 11
field_definitions.execution_budget: Resource limits - Phase 10 aborts if exceeded
field_definitions.decision_trace: Explainable decisions - which rules triggered experiment selection/rejection
field_definitions.deferral_reason: string: Why experiment postponed (resource constraints, dependencies)
field_definitions.rejection_reason: string: Why experiment cannot be run (exceeds capabilities, infeasible)

notes: This is the IMMUTABLE contract for Phase 10 - no changes after experiment starts
experiment_id becomes the primary key for tracking results through Phase 10/11/12/13
comparison_group enables fair quantum vs classical benchmarking in Phase 11
decision_trace provides auditable experiment selection - critical for scientific reproducibility
quantum_execution_params.shots affects both accuracy (more shots = stable estimate) and cost (more shots = more compute)
execution_budget prevents runaway experiments - Phase 10 enforces hard limits
Deferred experiments (P2) run only after P0/P1 validate pipeline
Rejected experiments never run - configuration infeasible for current environment
Phase 9 → Phase 10 handoff: experiment_config.json + dataset + representation + model definition
Classical experiments use full feature set or reduced representation depending on comparison group
Quantum experiments REQUIRE dimensionality reduction (Phase 6) before encoding
Backend abstraction allows same config to target local_sim, cloud_sim, or hardware with minimal changes
